articles.title: Chess.com’s next move is a new hub for classic games, from mahjong to sudoku
articles.summary: Chess.com announced Classic Games, a new platform with 10 more games including mahjong, sudoku, and checkers.
articles.body: Chess.com is ready to go a lot bigger than chess. After launching Gambit, a gambling-free poker site, earlier this year, the company is now adding 10 more games: backgammon, checkers, go, hearts, mahjong, shogi, sudoku, solitaire, xiangqi, and a Scrabble alternative called word. They’re all part of Chess’s new Classic Games platform, which is launching its public beta on Saturday on the web and through a new app for iOS and Android. “Our cofounders have had many people come up to them and say, ‘Hey, I run a mahjong night on Wednesdays’ or ‘I go to this local bar in Chicago with like five people, and we love playing go, but we lack a Chess.com,’” chief growth officer Albert Cheng says in an interview with The Verge. “The way that Chess.com has grown this community of almost 300 million members has not really happened for a lot of these other types of classic games.” Classic Games is aimed at filling that gap. Some of the new games, like shoji or xiangqi, are strategy games similar to chess while others are further afield, like sudoku, solitaire, and word. The Classic team chose the new games through “a mix of community feedback, market research, and then just our own confidence in our ability to serve that game well,” Cheng says. It’s focused on classics that “have some sort of lifelong journey of learning and a community.” [Image: [Image: [Image: [Image: Classic Games will feel familiar if you’ve ever played a match on Chess.com. Each game has lessons, leaderboards, and a rating system. Multiplayer games like checkers or mahjong have options for matches against other players or bots, and they use the same bot characters that Chess.com has. (Martin remains the lowest-rated bot across the board, whether it’s on Chess, Gambit, or Classic.) Not all of the games have the same play modes — word and mahjong have puzzles like chess, while sudoku has a set of daily grids and solitaire has daily deals. The expansion hasn’t put Chess.com itself on the back burner, according to Cheng. If anything, it’s never been better. “Chess is more and more so in the public zeitgeist than I’ve ever seen it, frankly, during my time here,” Cheng says. “Our daily active users are higher than they’ve ever been during the company’s history.” He declined to share exactly how many daily users Chess.com currently has but said the site is “doing amazingly well.” So, while the company is expanding beyond its domain name, chess remains its primary focus. “The amount of folks that are fully dedicated toward building new games is less than 1 percent of the company,” according to Cheng. [Image: [Image: [Image: [Image: AI played a key role in helping Chess.com launch 11 new games in a matter of months with a team of only a few people. Earlier this year, Cheng told The Verge his team built Gambit with the help of AI, mainly for coding tasks. He says they used “almost entirely the same approach” for Classic, with AI helping to speed up the coding process again. “Because these games are built on top of the Chess.com code base and design system and bot characters and rating systems, it’s a huge advantage and allows us to move very quickly alongside AI to bring these types of games to market with a very small team,” Cheng says. “As we create more and more games, the adjacent games that can be created to it just happen much faster because the infrastructure is there, as opposed to standing everything up from scratch.” AI wasn’t used for Classic Games’ art and design, Cheng says. “The look and feel of it is very carefully crafted by humans, and we’re proud of that,” he says. “The truth is, it really is a blend. It’s a small team of really talented folks that have good product and design judgment, and they’re leveraging AI.” Chess.com’s comfort with AI may come from the fact that human chess players have now spent decades playing and learning alongside machines. “We are fortunate in some ways that AI and chess have been intermixed for 30-ish years,” Cheng says, calling back to Garry Kasparov’s 1996 chess match against IBM’s Deep Blue supercomputer. “Even before the company was founded 20 years ago, the idea that AI was super powerful at the game of chess was embedded in how the cofounders thought about the company.” Elsewhere in the games industry, there’s been increasing tension over the use of AI. Cheng says that while Chess.com may be using AI to “accelerate” coding tasks, the creative side of things has become more important. “On the art and the design side, the ratios are shifting a decent amount, where we’re hiring more of those folks,” he says, adding that the company has “shipped a lot more major features in Chess.com than in previous years” using what they’ve learned from Classic Games’ faster development process. Chess.com might not be done growing its library of games, either. Cheng said it will likely expand to “a lot more” games in the future.

articles.title: Blade Director Says He Walked Away From Marvel's Canceled Movie Because 'Life's Too Short to Make S**t Films'
articles.summary: Director Bassam Tariq has opened up about why he exited Marvel's Blade movie, saying, "life's too short to make s**t films."
articles.body:
Director Bassam Tariq has opened up about why he exited Marvel's Blade movie, saying, "life's too short to make s**t films."

The Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother filmmaker explained his reasoning for walking away from the Mahershala Ali superhero period piece during an interview with The New Arab . With just one other feature film (Mogul Mowgli) under his belt at the time, working on Blade presented quite the opportunity, but his short time attached as the flick's first director wound up being more of a learning lesson than anything else.

"It was funny and strange to start casting and building without a proper script," Tariq said when asked what working in the studio system taught him. "You're sitting there and explaining to actors what their role will be, and they just have to believe you.

"That's also very dangerous because if the text comes and it doesn't add up to what you were saying, your credibility gets completely shot. All I have is my integrity, and I've been thinking about that a lot."

Marvel Studios announced an Ali-led Blade film in 2019 and picked Tariq to lead the charge in 2021. A little more than one year later, and the director was said to have bounced off the project , with Marvel telling The Hollywood Reporter that "shifts in our production schedule" were to blame.

Today, one new director and multiple frustrated Ali updates later, and Blade has been finally, officially canceled . Marvel Cinematic Universe orchestrator Kevin Feige said the process made him feel like a "gigantic loser and failure" – an assessment Ali agreed with – but for Tariq, the decision to cut off his relationship with Blade came down to how it was impacting his relationship with the film's actors. He told The New Arab that being "the bearer of bad news to your actors" while a corporate entity makes all of the major decisions in the background is "not a great way to be a director."

Avengers: Doomsday Poster Montage Gallery

"I know some people can take that and run with it, but I learned I was losing credibility with my actors, and it wasn't a healthy way to operate as a filmmaker. Life's too short to make s**t films, so that was my big lesson: I have to have full control over my script. If we disagree, it's between them and me. It's quite sad because we had such high hopes for what we wanted to build."

For now, as Marvel heads into another major release with next month's Avengers: Doomsday, there seems to be no sign of a live-action Blade for the MCU. Although the process of trying to get the movie out the door seems to have been tumultuous behind the scenes, there doesn't seem to be any bad blood from Tariq. In fact, when talking about how exiting the film made him feel like a failure last month, the director defended Feige, calling him a "good dude."

Although Ali's Blade never came to be, some of the effort put into the film did eventually see daylight. The actor went on to thank Marvel for the free year of physical training he got, which wound up helping him during the more intense scenes in Tariq's Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother. Costumes from Blade were also famously used in Ryan Coogler's Sinners .

articles.title: Neuralink Participant Showcases What It's Like to Play GTA 6 With His Mind
articles.summary: A Neuralink participant has shared a video showcasing how the technology has allowed him to drive boats, fly planes, and get in shootouts in GTA 6 with his mind.
articles.body:
A Neuralink participant has shared a video showcasing how the technology has allowed him to drive boats, fly planes, and get in shootouts in GTA 6 with his mind.

Neuralink shared a video of one of its few participants playing Rockstar Games' latest on social media yesterday. The two-minute highlight reel showed how the individual can use the brain implant tech to take Jason through Leonida with ease, saying that previous methods would often leave him sore.

Playing GTA VI with a Neuralink — Neuralink (@neuralink) November 20, 2026

"Before the old chip and surgery, I was using a mouth stick and an iPad," he explained. "I was essentially like a bird, just pecking at an iPad. There was a few games I could play, but obviously, it made your jaw sore and everything sore.

"So then, I get a chip, and it's like, 'What does this let me do?' Immediately, controlling a computer is like, 'boom.' Portal to the world. You just immediately get your portal to the world back."

Rockstar spent 13 years painstakingly crafting the world of GTA 6 to ensure every blade of grass and every line of dialogue was given an unprecedented amount of detail. Although it's maybe truer to life than some may have hoped, there's no denying that the amount of freedom the studio gives players to do everything from robbing banks to diving for sunken treasure has attracted tens of millions of players .

Despite guiding Jason and Lucia through GTA 6 by different means, the Neuralink participant shown today is one of those millions. In a follow-up post, the tech company, which was co-founded by controversial figure and billionaire Elon Musk, reiterated that the participant and others like him are part of an extremely limited clinical trial.

"Neuralink devices are investigational and have not been approved by the FDA or other regulatory authorities," it said. "This content features voluntary clinical trial participants sharing their personal experiences, which may not reflect all participants or future outcomes."

The first human patient to enter the Neuralink program used it to stay up all night playing Civilization 6 in 2024. A few months later, he was playing Slay the Spire .

If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .

articles.title: Digital Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 Games Are on Sale for Black Friday

We’ve almost made it to Black Friday . The official retail holiday lands on November 27 this year, but metric tons of deals are already available as we speak. That includes digital games for Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch. You can save up to 30% off a selection of games, which is about as much as you can ever expect to save on Nintendo games. So if you’ve had your eye on any of these and you want to play them in the next few months, this is probably the best price you’re going to get.

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Switch 2 Digital)

Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World (Switch 2 Digital)

What games are on sale? For Nintendo Switch 2, you can save a little on very recent releases, including the phenomenal The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake . It’s only $5 off, but it just came out. I beat it the other day, and I have to say I found playing it to be close to a religious experience. It’s that good. It’s the best-looking game Nintendo has ever released, and the 1998-era puzzle design holds up impossibly well . I loved every second of that game, and I look forward to replaying it in a year or so.

Other Switch 2 digital games on sale include the incredibly fun and destructive Donkey Kong Bananza . The open-world Mario Kart World is on sale, in case you didn’t get it bundled with your Switch 2. And a handful of other worthy releases are also on sale.

Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition (Switch Digital)

Donkey Kong Country Returns HD (Switch Digital)

Nintendo Kirby and the Forgotten Land (Switch Digital)

On the OG Nintendo Switch side of things, you have a number of games to choose from. My top recommendation would be Metroid Dread if you missed it when it originally launched in 2021. It’s getting a sequel in January called Metroid Ravenous , so you have plenty of time to catch up on Samus Aran’s previous adventures.

Other digital Switch games on sale include Kirby and the Forgotten Land , a 3D platformer that’s tons of fun. And then there are two souped-up ports of Wii games, if you can believe it. One is Donkey Kong Country Returns HD , which originally came out in 2010. The other is Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition , which was first released in the US in 2012. Don’t let the long-in-the-tooth age of those games fool you – they both still rule in 2026.

articles.body:
When exploring the Kingpin Bowling Illegal Operation in Grand Theft Auto VI , you may come across a safe that requires either Sticky Bombs or a code to get into. If you don't have explosives or simply want to open the door quietly, this official IGN GTA 6 guide walks you through how to find the bowling alley safe code location.

Kingpin Bowling Alley Safe Code Location in GTA 6

The code for the Kingpin Bowling safe is located at Brooks Boatworks , another Illegal Operation led by Kolt & Associates, which you’ll see a hint for if you read the notepad on the table in front of the safe. The Illegal Operation is also in Port Gellhorn, in the northern section.

The safe code is located in the building to the right of the Brooks Boatworks main warehouse , on the east side of the compound.

Go inside and look on the wall above the weapon case to spot a map you can inspect. Do so with L2 / LT and you’ll see three codes, including the one for the Kingpin Bowling alley safe, which is Tap to Reveal . The safe codes for the Brooks Boatworks and La Cascara Motel safes are here, too.
